reader.notes: Pairing runs over the whole clause's token stream in source order, which is what the 1985 text says ('by position in the SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS clause'). Values are correct with and without IN.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.4.5.3 SR8 and §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR8 (IN: integer-1 is the ordinal in the character set named by alphabet-name-2) and GR4d 5)/6) for THRU and ALSO alphabets.
